component: Exchange IDL enum naming and stored values

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted DeleteModel enum names PERMANENTLY_DELETE and MOVE_TO_TRASH within IExchangeIncomingServer instead of repeating an EWS_DELETEMODEL prefix. Its numeric0/1 values remain explicit compatibility facts; value1 deliberately aligns with IMAP defaults. Browser callers use the interface-qualified constants. This is a scoped accepted enum naming example, not permission to rename other public constants or change stored numbers. The separate unit task still spells the first name DELETE_PERMANENTLY, so it does not establish that spelling as an accepted interface declaration or verified test behavior.
title: Exchange delete-model constant names use their interface scope
